_comment: Model profiles for the agent driver. `--profile <name>` (and `--profiles a,b` on agentMatrix) fills provider, endpoint, model, and decoding settings from here; any command-line flag still overrides a profile for one run. Keys are driver option names; `serve` and `notes` are documentation only. Local models are reached over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint - `vllm serve` where vLLM supports the model, scripts/hf_chat_server.py otherwise; give each model its own port. See docs/server-setup.md.

qwen3-vl-2b-thinking.notes: Sampling is Qwen's recommendation for thinking mode. The thinking stays in the reply as <think> text; do not add --reasoning-parser unless you want it split into reasoning_content (both are captured).

gpt-5.5.notes: Hosted; the trace is a reasoning summary, not raw thinking.

claude-opus-5.notes: Hosted; the trace is a thinking summary, not raw thinking. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
